scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:bridge
scripts.plugin:pack: mkdir -p dist/plugin && npm pack ./plugins/dsh-bridge --json > dist/plugin/pack.json && node scripts/verify-plugin-pack.mjs dist/plugin/pack.json && mv "$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('dist/plugin/pack.json', 'utf8'))[0].filename)")" dist/plugin/
scripts.//smoke:dsh: Runs the bridge's own dsh client against a REAL `dsh web`, not FakeDshServer. Needs a live server first; see docs/REAL_DSH_SMOKE.md. Exits 2 (skip) if unreachable, so it is deliberately NOT part of `verify`.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck:all && npm run test && npm run bridge -- version
scripts.//verify: The trailing `bridge version` is not redundant: vitest transpiles TypeScript, so it cannot catch syntax that `node --experimental-strip-types` rejects (parameter properties, enums, namespaces, decorators). Running the real entry point is the only check that the shipped CLI still starts.
